verdict.rationale: Any firm with a public website could publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies to CMS IndusLaw. The probe of https://cms-induslaw.com/llms.txt returned HTTP 404. The rest of the evidence is ordinary practice-area and publication pages, with no machine- or agent-oriented documentation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
